thread:
Maya Singh: Quick shout — HelioRetail just went live on the Shopify App Store and signed a 12-month Dedicated pilot with Redwood (committed capacity + onboarding SOW). :tada:
Jon Park: Wait, Shopify App Store? link?
Maya Singh: Yep — listing is live here: https://shopify.com/apps/helio-redwood (internal marketing page: https://notion.redwood.com/helio-retail-launch). They chose mantic-10b-quant (8-bit) for NRT product recommendations, Dedicated pool with 4x A100 equiv, region NA/EU.
Priya Patel: This is huge. Do we have logos/one-pager for GTM?
Maya Singh: Uploading assets to the partner folder now. Also drafting a 1-pager for biz dev. cc @growth
Evan Brooks: Congrats team — any revenue numbers or ARR commit we can share in the channel?
Maya Singh: Contract is a 12-month pilot, $120k/mo committed usage + onboarding SOW ~$45k. Potential expansion into dedicated production next year.
Leo Ramirez: Nice — runtime config? batching/cache settings?
Maya Singh: Using auto-batching with max latency 200ms, prefix KV cache enabled for session continuity, warm-up policy in the SOW to reduce cold-starts. Our logs show 95th latency ~170ms in staging.
Jon Park: Is there a customer quote for the launch announcement?
Maya Singh: Onboarding POC lead gave this: "Redwood made integrating our recommender unbelievably fast; latency and cost hit our targets on day 1." I'll ask for an approved quote.
Priya Patel: I'll coordinate a co-marketing plan — social post + case study + webinar. Any preferred dates?
Maya Singh: Aim for next Thursday to coincide with Shopify App feature slot. I'll loop in legal for the quote approval.
partnerships-bot: :white_check_mark: HelioRetail listing detected. Partner metadata updated in Salesforce -> Opportunity #OPP-4821 created.
Evan Brooks: Can the eng-ml team prioritize a short health-check with Helio in the first week of pilot? @Leo Ramirez
Leo Ramirez: Yep, we can run a telemetry sweep and do a 1-hr runbook walkthrough. I'll set up the meeting.
Maya Singh: Thanks everyone — big win for partnerships + retail GTM. Will post the finalized case study draft here when it's ready. :rocket:
